sources.entry: Kanboard - Simple visual task board. (Source Code) MIT PHP

summary.one_liner: Kanboard is a PHP project management application built around the Kanban methodology, with visual task boards.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Kanboard as project management software focused on Kanban. It is explicitly in maintenance mode: the author is not building major new features, only small fixes, while releases continue depending on community contributions. Pull requests for new features and bug fixes are still accepted if they follow the project guidelines. The README links to a feature list, changelog, forum, and official documentation covering requirements, installation, upgrades, and Docker use, but the README itself does not list specific features. Metadata from awesome-selfhosted describes it as a simple visual task board.
use_cases: Visual Kanban task boards for projects
Managing to-do lists and task workflow
how_to_run: Read the official documentation for requirements and installation instructions
Use Kanboard with Docker (see the official documentation)
notable: Maintenance mode: only small fixes by the author, community pull requests accepted
Docker usage documented in official docs
caveats: In maintenance mode: no major new features are being developed by the author
README gives no detail on specific requirements or features; refer to official documentation
